legal.contextNote: The Bombay High Court held that the State cannot invoke the Maharashtra Industrial Development Act, 1961 (MID Act) to acquire 84 hectares of land belonging to Tata Power for a private benefit disguised as a public purpose. No specific precedent was cited in the article; comparable authority includes State of Maharashtra v. M/s. Hindustan Construction Co. (1995) 3 SCC 1, which stressed the ‘public purpose’ test.
